measure.name: Restore — изграждане на нови мощности за съхранение на електрическа енергия
measure.fund: Национален план за възстановяване и устойчивост (НПВУ)
measure.note: Two rounds. RESTORE 1 ranked 82 of ~151 projects in 2024–2025; RESTORE 2 ranked in December 2025. Combined envelope ~1.149 billion BGN. The measure drew scrutiny because many approved beneficiaries trace to politicians, ex-ministers and well-known businessmen.

confirmed.description: EU-funds beneficiaries cross-referenced against investigative journalism. Each case is a company named by Bulgarian media as a politically-connected recipient of Recovery-Plan money, whose grant is corroborated by the ИСУН 2020 public register (data/funds/). The `register` figures are this project's own data (ИСУН 'Договорени средства' — the total contracted project value: EU grant + the beneficiary's own co-financing). The `claim` figures are only what the cited journalism reported. BGN/EUR peg 1.95583.
